recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the problem recurs, investigate publisher/deployment generation of *.canonical.* example artifacts rather than changing the MessageHeader example or removing canonical-form template links.
issue_request: FHIR-24687 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the FHIR-core messaging page. It reported that message-request-link.xml.html linked to message-request-link.canonical.xml as the canonical form, but that target returned 404; later Jira comments noted this appeared to affect generated canonical-form links for resource examples generally.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-24687 was found. The XML and JSON example templates already contained the canonical-form link token before the issue was filed, and later history only moved those templates to tools/templates and adjusted nearby example header/narrative rendering without changing the canonical target. The issue appears to have been a build/publication tooling or deployment problem rather than a missing source edit.
additional_context: MessageHeader is active in source/fhir.ini, assigned to InM, and its example list includes message-request-link, which source/messaging.html links as the example request message. InM Confluence minutes from 2022-01-18 recorded FHIR-24687 as still broken, but targeted Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related final issue or conflicting rationale. Current build.fhir.org and hl7.org/fhir pages link to message-request-link.canonical.xml, and those canonical XML targets now return HTTP 200; build.fhir.org/patient-example.canonical.xml also returns HTTP 200.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source still intentionally generates canonical-form links for examples, the affected messaging example remains in current build scope, and the public generated canonical-form artifacts now resolve.
